youtube_description:
In which John chats with Turtles All the Way Down movie director Hannah Marks about dogs, thought spirals, car colors, and more. It is very hard to get 15 minutes of a director's time on a movie set, so HUGE THANKS to Hannah for doing this. Follow her on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hannahgmarks/?hl=en
p.s. yes, there is an extended cut: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d0IxEPp2CS8
